provenance: Manually authored fictional sentences for a small text-classification experiment. Training and held-out examples are separate authored scenarios, not generated variants of shared sentence templates. Neither split contains real patient records. Labels describe a current patient barrier; resolved, denied, hypothetical, family-only, and neutral statements are none.
